description: Maharashtra govt has directed energy authorities to use artificial intelligence (AI) to ensure smooth electricity generation and uninterrupted power supply
body_lead: Maharashtra pushes for AI use in power supply to manage high summer demands Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis instructed the Energy Department and related agencies to adopt AI-based systems for better monitoring, maintenance and management of power generation and distribution CM Fadnavis said AI should be used to strengthen planning, reduce faults, and improve real-time response during high-demand periods.
